answer_1.quote: We propose iCOPERNICUS, a novel evaluation framework for analyzing the capability of true In-Context Personalization Learning (ICPL) in LLMs for the personalized summarization task.
answer_1.outputs: personalized summaries (headlines) generated for news articles

answer_2.quote: We use EGISES-JSD as the comparative measure within the iCOPERNICUS framework to evaluate system-level strong degree-of-ICPL (i.e., σ in definitions 3 and 4 is JSD).

answer_4.quote: Human‑Judgment Validation: We further validated PX‑5 ... using survey‑based unbiased judgments (i.e., similarity ratings (1 (low) –6 (very high)) on summary‑pairs, both reference and model‑generated, from 339 respondents.
answer_4.guideline: Participants rated similarity of summary pairs on a 1‑6 Likert scale.
